artworks.title: Four Arowak Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals - three adults and one child - with their full bodies visible. The child stands on the left holding a stick, while an adult male stands next to him with a spear. Another male figure stands in the center holding a staff and shield, while a female sits on the right. The background features a gradient sky and a grassy landscape.

artworks.title: Zurumati Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people in a natural setting with a forest background. The scene depicts a circle of figures standing on grass, surrounded by lush greenery and a sky with soft cloud formations. Most of the individuals are adorned with distinctive headwear featuring colorful feathers. The central figure stands slightly apart from the group, with a more elaborate headdress and additional body adornments. This is in the style of George Catlin, known for his detailed and vivid portrayals of Native American life and culture during the 19th century. The setting conveys a sense of community and cultural expression, set against a serene and harmonious natural backdrop.

artworks.title: Three Zurumati Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side. The person on the left holds a wooden object and a long bow. They have shoulder-length dark hair with colorful feathers, a necklace, and minimal clothing. The person in the middle holds a large ceremonial staff, has shoulder-length dark hair with feathers, a beaded necklace, and a loincloth. The person on the right holds a long spear, has similar hair, and wears a necklace and a loincloth. They are all barefoot. The background is simple with soft blue and brown tones, and the ground appears grassy. The frame has a muted green border.

artworks.title: Four Zurumati Children
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing next to each other. The first person has short dark hair and raised arms, the second person has short dark hair and arms akimbo. The third person holds a shield and spear, and wears a feathered headdress. The fourth person has arms resting at their front. The background has a blue-gray cloud-like form that fades into light tan with a greenish tint around the edges.

artworks.title: Four Macouchi Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts four people shown from head to toe standing side by side. The individuals appear to be standing upright with their arms resting naturally at their sides or holding objects. The people have long dark hair adorned with colorful feathers. Their facial features are distinct with prominent cheekbones and eyes. They are minimally clothed, wearing loincloths with various decorative adornments. The two individuals on the left hold bows, and one also holds an axe. They wear necklaces and some have arm and leg bands. The man second from the left also has a bow and an arrow in his left hand. The background is a simple gradient of earthy tones with a subtle suggestion of grass under their feet. The image is framed by a thick grey-green border.

artworks.title: A Connibo Indian Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays six individuals standing in a row against a plain background. The central figure is a man with dark hair adorned with feathers and shells, wearing a necklace and a fringed skirt. Flanking him are two women with long dark hair, one holding a pot on her head. Two young children stand between them, wearing similar attire. On the far right stands a young boy with feathers in his hair, holding a bow. The background is plain with a muted teal border.

artworks.title: Bride and Groom on Horseback - Connibo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals riding a dark-colored horse. Both are sitting upright and facing forward. The person at the front has well-defined facial features, including dark eyes and mouth, and has hair adorned with feathers. They are dressed in minimal clothing and are holding a lance. The individual seated behind appears to have straight dark hair and similar minimal clothing. The surroundings feature tall grass with various small flowers, against a softly painted background that transitions from blue sky to muted earth tones. The composition is bordered by a light gray-green frame.

artworks.title: A Chetibo Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image presents a depiction of three individuals standing next to each other. The middle person has medium-length dark hair, a tall feathered headdress, distinctive facial features, painted chest designs, a waist covering, necklaces, bracelets, and an arm band. To the left, a young figure with dark hair and facial markings is wearing minimal clothing with painted chest designs and bracelets. On the right, another person with medium-length dark hair, feathered earrings, and an elaborately beaded top is wearing arm and ankle decorations, along with a patterned waist covering. The background shows a softly painted, abstract outdoor landscape with green foliage and a neutral sky, framed in muted tones.

artworks.title: Four Sepibo Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four people in traditional clothing standing in a line. The child is on the far left, and the adults wear decorative hair accessories. They are adorned with jewelry and the woman carries a baby on her back. The background displays a soft green landscape.

artworks.title: Five Iquito Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals standing closely together. In the center, a male figure stands with a tall feather headdress, facial paint, and necklaces. To his left, a shorter male figure stands, wearing a similar headdress and facial paint. The figure to his right is a young male child wearing a necklace and decorated bands. To the left of this group is a woman holding a paddle-like object. On the far right, a crouched young child is holding a bow with an arrow poised to shoot. The background is a soft blur of earthy and pastel shades.

artworks.title: Three Omagua Men
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in a row. Each person has shoulder-length dark hair with colorful feathers. They wear minimal clothing and jewelry. One person holds a feathered spear, while the others have decorative adornments. The background is a light-colored sky with subtle cloud patterns near the bottom, suggesting an outdoor setting with grass under their feet.

artworks.title: Four Xingu Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image features four individuals standing in a row. The two adult males on the left hold spears. They have long black hair with feathers and wear grass skirts. The first male wears a shield and the second carries a bow and quiver. Beside the second male stands a woman with a bare torso wearing necklaces and bracelets. The woman also wears a short skirt and has decorated hair. A young child stands next to the woman, unclothed with short hair. The background shows a serene setting with clouds in blue tones and a green border.

artworks.title: Four Angustura Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing. The first person is on the left, holding a spear, with their back to the viewer. The second person is facing forward, holding a paddle-like instrument. The third person faces forward with hands at their sides. The fourth person faces forward with arms crossed. All individuals wear necklaces, arm bands, and leg bands, and minimal clothing. The background has grass and greenery with a neutral sky. The color scheme is earthy with soft, muted colors.

artworks.title: Four Mura Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals against an abstract background. The first adult, on the left, is a woman with long, dark hair, wearing a shawl and holding a small unclothed child. In the center, a man stands with a raised arm holding a spear. The third adult, on the right, stands with a relaxed posture holding a bow. The background is soft-hued with a grassy ground underneath the individuals.

artworks.title: Marahua Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals in an outdoor setting. Two seated men at the center have long dark hair, with one wearing a feathered headpiece. They have facial markings or tattoos, wear loincloths, and beaded necklaces. A woman and a child stand to the left, with two other figures, including a child, in a canoe in water in the background. The scene is by water with grassy land under an open sky.

artworks.title: Orejona Chief and Family
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals in a natural setting. Two adults and three children are depicted in full-body view. In the center, an adult male with long black hair, colorful feathers, and facial markings is bare-chested, wearing a cloth around his waist and beaded jewelry. He holds a long wooden paddle or staff. To his left is a child with similar features, feathers, and a bow. On the right, an adult female with tied-back hair, wearing a necklace and draped in a cloth, holds the hand of a naked child and carries another on her back. The background is a gradient of light colors with a green border.

artworks.title: Orejona Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of individuals gathered in front of a simple shelter made from natural materials, set against a backdrop of lush greenery. The scene is captured in a realistic style with careful attention to the details of the environment and physical characteristics. The group appears to be in a relaxed, communal setting with an emphasis on familial or social bonds. This is in style of George Catlin, known for his depictions of Native American life and culture in the 19th century. The painting emphasizes the cultural and natural setting through its composition and color palette.

artworks.title: Three Chaymas Men
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three men are shown standing side by side, facing each other. The man on the left holds a spear, has short dark hair, high cheekbones, and a determined expression. He wears a fringed garment, loose shorts, and decorations on his ankles and biceps. The central man stands with his hands on his hips, wearing a feathered headdress and a fringed garment with a belt. He has a decorated shoulder strap and a quiver of arrows on his back. The man on the right holds a bow, and a shield on his back, with bands on his arms and neck. The background is a warm gradient.

artworks.title: Chaco Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals standing in a row. The person on the left has tousled hair, holds a bow and arrow, and has broad facial features with a strong jawline. The central figure has straight shoulder-length hair, a neutral expression, and carries a bow. The figure on the right has hair parted in the middle and worn in a bob style, standing with hands at their sides. All three wear traditional clothing made from natural materials. The background shows a painterly depiction of greenery with a soft, blurred effect.

artworks.title: Members of the Payaguas Tribe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts five individuals standing side by side. On the left is a young child and an adult male, both in minimal clothing. In the center are two adorned adult males, and on the right is a woman holding an infant. The background is simple with a light, natural tone.

artworks.title: Lengua Chief, His Two Wives, and Four Children
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five individuals and a baby standing in a row. In the center, there is an adult male holding a stick and a bow. He has long dark hair with red and white feathers, distinctive cheekbones, and wears jewelry. A woman beside him holds a baby, while three other children stand to the left. All individuals have long dark hair and wear beaded jewelry, with one child wearing a feather. The background is earth-toned with a green border.

artworks.title: Lengua Medicine Man with Two Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Members of the Botocudo Tribe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing in various poses. One person on the left has a hand on the hip, while the second person holds a spear. The third person has their back to the viewer, and the fourth person also holds a spear. The individuals have Native American facial features, dark hair, and wear traditional clothing with adornments. The background shows an open landscape with soft colors.

artworks.title: Botocudo Chief, His Wife, and a Young Man
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in full body. On the left, a person stands holding a paddle and a basket. They have long dark hair and wear a red garment with red leg coverings. In the center, another person stands with a spear, draped in an orange-red textile. They have dark hair and wear large circular earrings. On the right, a person stands holding a stick-like object, wearing a shorter garment with red accents and dark hair. The background is softly painted in light blues and beiges, suggesting an outdoor setting.
